title: EventBus callback add-then-remove listener recovery contract

contract.callback_mutation_isolation: A listener can add and subsequently remove another listener during callback execution without aborting EventBus.emit()
contract.current_cycle_add_isolation: A listener added during an active broadcast does not receive that same broadcast
contract.next_cycle_add_continuity: A listener added during one broadcast receives the subsequent broadcast
contract.current_cycle_remove_continuity: A listener removed during a callback still receives the current broadcast exactly once
contract.post_remove_isolation: A listener removed during a callback receives no subsequent broadcasts
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid throughout add-then-remove recovery
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Callback-driven add/remove operations preserve exactly one listener entry per active owner
contract.delivery_once: Each currently registered listener receives each applicable broadcast exactly once
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful across add, remove, and post-removal cycles
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
